notes.title: Blaster Master Zero 3 Various small fixes have been implemented
notes.content:
(Updated August 31, 2021)

* Various small fixes have been implemented.

notes.title: Blaster Master Zero 3 Support for Cloud Saves has been added
notes.content:
(Updated August 24, 2021)

* Support for Cloud Saves has been added.

notes.title: Blaster Master Zero 3 has been updated!
notes.content:
(Updated August 20, 2021)

* Item icons on the mini-map will now appear as different colors depending on item type as follows:
    - LIFE ENERGY GUARD α (Pink)
    - LIFE ENERGY GUARD β (Green)
    - Other items (Light blue)

* An issue where performing certain actions the moment G-SOPHIA SV clings to a wall could cause the game to freeze has been fixed.

* Various other small fixes have been implemented.

notes.title: Blaster Master Zero 3 has been updated!
notes.content:
(Updated August 11, 2021)

* Fixed an issue where control configuration would be reset.

* Fixed an issue where the confirm button would conflict with actions after changing controls.

* Some areas where the player may have gotten stuck or out of bounds have been revised.

* Various other small fixes have been implemented.

notes.title: Blaster Master Zero 3 has been updated!
notes.content:
(Updated August 3, 2021)

* An issue where a certain cut-scene would be unintentionally skipped has been fixed.

* Various other small fixes have been implemented.

notes.title: Blaster Master Zero 3 Demo - Now features more playable content!
notes.content:
* The demo now features more playable content! Whether you've tried the demo already or not, there's some new BMZ3 to experience for you before the demo ends!

* The following languages are now supported:
    FRENCH
    ITALIAN
    GERMAN
    SPANISH
    PORTUGUESE

notes.title: Blaster Master Zero 3 Playthough with the dev team!
notes.content:
Greetings to all you masters of blasting out there! We really hope you're enjoying the Blaster Master Zero 3 demo so far! 

We got the BMZ3 team here live at INTI CREATES HQ to showcase the game and take your questions! These guys love to mark special occasions like this, so they're probably gonna have something special up their sleeve! See you there!

notes.title: Bug fixed - Blaster Master Zero 3 Demo
notes.content:
* An error that causes the game's visuals to get messed up when booted up in windowed mode with certain display settings has been fixed.
* Resolution options have been added to enable up to "x8" size.
* Various issues have been fixed.
